title: Here’s How to Watch ‘Drag Race México’ Season 3 Online From Anywhere in the World
summary: Don't miss the season 3 premiere of Drag Race México on July 30, and find out where to stream it online.
contentText:

The queens are back. Drag Race México returns July 30 for its third season, bringing a new lineup of performers ready to compete through runway challenges, lip-sync battles and high-energy performances for the chance to become Mexico’s next drag superstar. 

The latest installment of the RuPaul’s Drag Race international franchise will once again feature drag legends Lolita Banana and Taiga Brava as hosts, with Óscar Madrazo joining the judging panel.

How to Watch Drag Race México Season 3

Drag Race México season three premieres July 30 and will be available to stream on WOW Presents Plus for international viewers in the United States. Fans in Mexico can watch the series on Paramount+ .

How to Watch Drag Race México Season 3 From Outside Mexico

Viewers outside Mexico can stream Drag Race México season three on WOW Presents Plus. For fans traveling or accessing content from a region where the series is unavailable, a virtual private network (VPN) can help connect to streaming services from different locations around the world.

The Mexican edition of RuPaul’s Drag Race first premiered in 2023, expanding the franchise’s growing lineup of international adaptations. After quickly building a fanbase, the series saw a major boost in viewership during its second season, which drew 40% more viewers than its debut. That success led World of Wonder, the multiplatform media company behind the global Drag Race franchise, to announce a third season of the competition series.

“The dream of Drag Race México has been a long time coming. Fans lobbied hard for years, and when the show launched, their support and engagement was total euphoria. The artists in the show and the audience’s love for them embody everything Drag Race should be,” World of Wonder co-founders Fenton Bailey and Randy Barbato told Variety . “After the runaway success of Seasons 1 and 2, we are thrilled to announce Season 3. Through their bedazzling creativity and diverse talents, the queens of Mexico serve a feast of pure joy.”

Season three continues the global expansion of the RuPaul’s Drag Race franchise , with queens competing through a series of challenges, runway presentations and lip-sync battles as they fight for the crown.
